title: Figure 18. Mach Cone Generated by a Supersonic Object
description: Diagram of a yellow supersonic object trailing a wake and producing a conical bow shock (Mach cone) that reaches the ground, where an "Acoustic Detector" sits at height H below the object and horizontal distance D. The Mach angle is labeled "β = arcsin(1/M) = Mach Angle." Captioned "Figure 18. Mach Cone Generated by a Supersonic Object"; text below discusses Los Alamos infrasound detector stations and meteor detection.
